name: Image Converter
description: Batch convert, resize and compress PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, ICO and TIFF images
help: Images are decoded, resized and re-encoded by the local Rust engine as a background task with live logs.
Photos are rotated upright from their EXIF orientation; re-encoding drops EXIF and other metadata.
Output never overwrites existing files: a number is appended when a name is taken.
Drag images onto the window to add them.
